title: Lesson 15. Drawing in Paint
description: Pencil, brushes, eraser, fill, shapes, palette and the "My house" drawing

questions.prompt: Match the tool with what it does
Which keys undo a mistake in Paint?
A shape grows when you drag it with the mouse.
questions.explain: That is how circles and squares are drawn.

questions.prompt: Which tool writes text on a drawing?

questions.text: The house wall is a ___, the roof a ___.

questions.prompt: Put in order how to save the drawing
Paint spilled over the whole page. What now?
options: Ctrl + Z and look for a gap in the line

questions.prompt: Paint's eraser erases what you drew.

learn.intro: Paint is a computer sketchbook. Best of all — you can undo any mistake!

slides.text: The **pencil** draws thin lines. **Brushes** — thick lines, like a marker. The **eraser** erases. The **palette** picks colours.
**Shapes** — ready circles, squares, stars. Drag with the mouse — the shape grows.

check.prompt: Which tool draws thick lines like a marker?

slides.text: The **fill** (bucket) pours paint into a closed area. If there is a gap — the paint runs over the whole page!
Paint spilled? **Ctrl + Z** — the time machine, then check the line for a gap.

check.prompt: If the line has a gap, the fill spills over the whole page.

slides.text: Draw "My house": the wall is a rectangle, the roof a triangle, colour with the fill, a tree and sun with the brush. Text — the **A** tool.
Save: File → Save As → your folder → Pictures → "My house".
